This is an equation of a circular arc of radius $2$ centered at the origin in the $xy$-plane. 
The arc lies in the first and second quadrants between the polar rays $\theta = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$ and $\theta = \dfrac{2\pi}{3},$ as shown below.
